title: Which countries will launch a joint peace fund for the Israel–Palestine conflict by June 2026?
lesson: For exact coalition questions, do not assume the answer is a two-country pair. Include plausible three-country blocs and Commonwealth combinations, and retain Australia when Canada and the United Kingdom are central candidates.

title: Who will replace Japan's injured captain in its 2026 World Cup squad by June 12, 2026?
lesson: An injury replacement need not be position-for-position. Build the candidate pool from the full standby and recently omitted roster, including attackers, before concentrating on players who resemble the injured captain tactically.
